svg.text: Pantry R35 — sanitized source excerpt
Connect the cabinet backing (printed page 19)
Text-only card: no address, parcel or permit identity and no raw source links. Quotations keep the printed wording.
printed page 19
HOLD: resolve opposing angles before buying backing hardware
printed page 19
Keep all 25 dry 2×6 blocks, flat: 5½-in face vertical, 1½-in depth. Keep the cabinet fastening plane
flush to the pantry-side studs.
printed page 19
The angle leg is 1 7/16 in, so it can fit within the 2-in space behind a flat block. Its 2½-in bend
length can run vertically on the 5½-in block face. This checks space only; load direction, screw layout
and tool access are still required.
printed page 19
03. At studs shared by adjacent blocks, do not install angles on both sides of the 1½-in stud using this
generic detail. ESR-3096 requires 3-in minimum wood thickness for opposing angles. Vertical staggering
is not a documented exception.
printed page 19
Do not order 50 angles for 25 blocks by multiplication. The final quantity is unresolved. Shelf brackets
remain attached to verified full studs with their own hardware; backing angles do not replace shelf
brackets or cabinet mounting screws.
Source family: r35-p19-backing-connection.svg · printed page 19 of the R35 conditional plan (29 pages).
